create_MultiLayerEagleWorker: create a MultiLayerEagleWorker instance for multi-layer speculative decoding with a target model worker
run_forward_batch_generation: run speculative decoding forward on a schedule batch with draft and verify steps
run_draft: run the draft model to generate speculative tokens using top-k sampling across multiple steps
run_verify: verify draft tokens against the target model and accept matching tokens for the batch
run_forward_draft_extend: run the draft model extend pass to prefill the draft KV cache with target hidden states
